panels.title: Ostatni kontakt

targets.query:
from(bucket: "flora")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sys" and r._field == "uptime_s")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.description: Ile sekund temu przyszla ostatnia telemetria systemowa (robot wysyla ja co 5 s). Pomaranczowy powyzej 30 s, czerwony powyzej 2 min.

panels.title: Napiecie baterii

targets.query:
from(bucket: "flora")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power" and r._field =~ /^v$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Temperatura

targets.query:
union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "flora")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temp" and r._field =~ /^c_\d+$/)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "DS18B20 " + r._field})),
  from(bucket: "flora")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather" and r._field == "t_c")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "BME280 (glowica)"}))
])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.description: DS18B20 w bryle i BME280 w glowicy - ta sama jednostka, wiec na jednym wykresie.

panels.title: Logi robota (ostrzezenia i bledy)
panels.description: Linie W i E z logu ESP, wysylane na tele/log. t_ms to czas od startu robota.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "flora")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "log")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "lvl", "tag", "msg"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)

panels.title: Historia aktualizacji OTA
panels.description: Stany koncowe z tele/ota: confirmed, failed (z powodem), rebooting.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "flora")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ota" and r._field != "pct")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state == "confirmed" or r.state == "failed" or r.state == "rebooting")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "state", "current", "to", "err"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
